info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Operational Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Operational Services Retrieval API allows consumers to access detailed channel activity history based on specified parameters. This functionality is crucial for banking institutions and financial service providers seeking to monitor and analyze operational activities effectively. By querying the API with the appropriate parameters, users can retrieve insightful data for compliance, reporting, or operational analysis. Typical consumers include banking analysts, compliance officers, and system integrators aiming to enhance their operational oversight.

get.description: This operation fetches the channel activity history for the specified resource identifier. It allows users to view past activities related to the channel, providing insights and historical data necessary for analysis or reporting.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the channel activity history for the specified resource. It includes necessary parameters to filter the results based on the desired criteria.
